text:
marta: onboarding heads-up — new multi-tenant customer 'Orion' needs hub-transit + PrivateLink to partner analytics in ap-southeast-1. We need quota bumps and routing confirmation before we cut them over. TL;DR: big ENI, EIP, and NAT needs + 40 A100s reserved.

jay: got it. can you paste the CIDRs and exact quota numbers we should request? also which account (org/project) will they be in?

marta: they will be in a new child account under org-redwood-prod (account id 987654321). required details below:
```
Hub VPC: 10.40.0.0/16
Tenant VPCs (4): 10.41.0.0/16, 10.42.0.0/16, 10.43.0.0/16, 10.44.0.0/16
Expected ENIs (initial): 500 (burst to 900 over 30d)
SNAT ports: estimate 200k concurrent connections (need port capacity or NAT scaling)
NAT Gateways: 6 (per-AZ HA + tenant-dedicated pairs)
EIPs: 12 reserved (initial)
A100 quota: 40 (on-demand), want reserved-plan discussion
Region: ap-southeast-1 (Sydney)
PrivateLink endpoints: partner-analytics.sl.redwood (3 endpoints across AZs)
Route table scale: 800 routes expected for transit attachments + on-prem VPNs
```

amy: quick note — if we do per-tenant NAT GW EIPs we may hit account EIP limits fast. recommend we either use centralized egress with per-tenant SNAT mapping or ask cloud for a higher EIP limit. also watch for SNAT port exhaustion on NAT GW (classic NGW has 64k ports per IP). :warning:

jay: +1. options: 1) request additional EIP quota + increase NAT GW throughput 2) use an Elastic Fabric NAT/Private NAT solution (if provider supports) 3) push customers to use endpoint-based egress (ILB) for heavy traffic. For immediate onboarding, we should request: ENI 1000, EIP 50, NAT GW 12, A100 40. That gives headroom for bursts.

cloud-accounts: @marta thanks — please attach cost justification, expected QPS, and timeline. Use this template when filing the support request: 
```
Subject: Quota increase request — ap-southeast-1 (Org 987654321)
Body:
- Service: EC2 (ENI/EIP/NAT GW)
- Current quota: <list current>
- Requested quota: ENI 1000, EIP 50, NAT_GATEWAYS 12, A100 40
- Justification: onboarding 4 tenants (Orion) with estimated 200k concurrent connections, HA across 3 AZs, PrivateLink endpoints required for partner analytics, peak expected in 4 weeks.
- Timeline: need approval within 7 business days to meet onboarding window.
- Contact: marta@redwood.com, +1-555-0102
```

cloud-accounts: For GCP equivalents (if they land in gcp): please include quota names (e.g., "Static External IP Addresses", "VM-EXT-ENI-LIMIT") and project numbers — we can pre-fill. Also attach a network diagram (simple PNG).

marta: adding network diagram + traffic profile to the ticket now. also note partner will require PrivateLink service names and we need to set up AWS Network Load Balancer <-> PrivateLink config.

jay: two operational concerns: 1) route table scale on the transit GW (we should limit per-attachment routes and use propagated prefixes via TGW/Transit) 2) ensure we tag route tables/service endpoints so Console + Console SRE tooling can filter per-tenant.

amy: on SNAT port risk: if provider can't increase port capacity we should plan for sticky egress pools (per-tenant) and consider source NAT using multiple EIPs per NAT gateway. Also add autoscaling policy for NAT instance fallback.

marta: noted. i'll request ENI/EIP/NAT/A100 increases and ask for expedited review. i'll include the fallback plan in the ticket.

sre-bot: ticket INFRA-4321 created (assignee: cloud-accounts). SLA: vendor review estimate 5-10 business days. Attachments: network-diagram-orion.png, traffic-estimate.csv

cloud-accounts: starting the support case now. if vendor asks for additional justification, tag this thread and we'll coordinate.

jay: one more ask — can eng-infra pre-approve a transient pool of spot capacity for initial evaluation? that reduces immediate A100 demand on quota.

marta: yes we can spin up temporary spot pools. i'll coordinate with eng-runtime to limit access.

amy: thanks — keeping an eye on cost. please add estimated monthly cost delta to the ticket (EIPs, NAT data processing, A100 runtime hours).

marta: will do. Plan: file full quota request today, enable spot pools until quota approved, and then switch to reserved A100s once quota and finance sign-off complete. Will update here when support response arrives. :thumbsup:
